# Toy binary kit (`toy_binary`)

> Test-only kit on artificial data. Educational/research use only; not a clinical tool.

## What is the clinical question?
A toy question used to exercise Template A; see [construction](construction.md#2-clinical--dataset-definition).
## What official documentation was used?
None — the toy kit uses only the fixture methods note; see [construction](construction.md#1-official-documentation).
## How was the cohort created?
Adults by a provisional toy age rule; see [construction](construction.md#4-cohort-cases-and-controls).
## How were positive labels (cases) created?
Two fictional diagnosis codes on distinct days; see [construction](construction.md#4-cohort-cases-and-controls).
## How were controls created?
A normal fictional marker and no diagnosis, sampled 2:1; see [construction](construction.md#4-cohort-cases-and-controls).
## What is the index (as-of) time?
Second diagnosis date for cases; an outpatient visit for controls; see [construction](construction.md#5-index-and-cutoff-rules).
## Which features are included?
See [features](features.md#included-features).
## Which features are deliberately excluded, and why?
See [features](features.md#excluded-features).
## How do raw fields map to framework features?
See [features](features.md#mapping-trace).
## Which decisions come directly from documentation?
None (toy); see [construction](construction.md#1-official-documentation).
## Which decisions are project-specific methodological choices?
All of them; see [construction](construction.md#7-kit-definition-configuration).
## Which items remain unverified?
Every value is provisional; see the [verification log](verification_log.md).
